clusters.label: Thermoelectric performance (ionic)
clusters.definition: Overall performance of thermoelectric materials or cells operating through ionic transport.
clusters.reason: The supplied contexts identify ionic thermoelectric systems. Different formulations and improvement mechanisms qualify the claims, while the performance concept is shared.

clusters.label: Thermoelectric performance
clusters.definition: Overall thermoelectric performance discussed through bonding, structural distortion, or thermal and electrical transport.
clusters.reason: These passages use the broad performance concept without defining a particular metric or explicitly isolating an ionic or thermogalvanic subtype.

clusters.label: Thermoelectric performance (electronic)
clusters.definition: Thermoelectric performance associated with electronic carrier transport in conducting materials.
clusters.reason: The carrier, electronic-structure, conducting-polymer, and solid-state transport contexts support a shared electronic thermoelectric performance concept. Material identities and proposed improvements remain claim-specific.

clusters.label: Thermoelectric performance (calculated)
clusters.definition: Thermoelectric performance evaluated using first-principles electronic and transport calculations.
clusters.reason: All three explicitly describe calculated performance. They remain separate from performance reported without this computational qualification.

clusters.label: Thermoelectric performance (thermoelectrochemical cells)
clusters.definition: Thermoelectric performance of electrolyte-based thermoelectrochemical cells.
clusters.reason: The title explicitly identifies thermoelectrochemical cells, and the relations concern statistical determinants of their performance.

clusters.label: Thermoelectric performance (P/λ evaluation)
clusters.definition: Performance of a mixed ion-electron conducting thermoelectric cell evaluated by optimal output power density divided by active-material thermal conductivity.
clusters.reason: The evidence specifies both a mixed-conduction system and a particular performance evaluation ratio.

clusters.label: Capacitance
clusters.definition: Electrical charge-storage capacity per unit potential difference.
clusters.reason: Both refer to electrical capacitance. Material composition, frequency dependence, and polarization explanations qualify the measurements rather than change the quantity.

clusters.label: Thermoelectric power (mixed ionic-electronic)
clusters.definition: Net thermopower in conductors whose response involves ionic and electronic transport.
clusters.reason: The evidence connects thermopower with mixed conduction, electronic contributions, or ionic transference numbers. These are net responses, not separately identified ionic or electronic coefficients.

clusters.label: Thermoelectric power (electronic)
clusters.definition: Thermopower characterizing the electrical response to a temperature difference in electronic transport.
clusters.reason: Electronic states, semiconductor carrier type, reduced transition-metal fractions, or electronic defect compensation establish electronic thermopower. Carrier signs and sample compositions remain attached to their claims.

clusters.label: Thermoelectric power (c-axis)
clusters.definition: Thermopower measured along the c-axis of sodium hydride graphite intercalation compounds.
clusters.reason: The title specifies the measurement direction; the evidence additionally identifies a predominantly phonon-drag interpretation.

clusters.reason: The contexts identify thermopower as a transport property, including explicit notation S or TEP, but do not establish a shared narrower carrier or directional subtype.
